title: Mixed fiber, network and billing fault
description: Customer is offline, ONU shows red LOS, PPPoE is inactive, payment is recorded but the account remains disabled.

title: Weak optical signal
description: The customer reports an unstable connection and the ONU RX power is weak.
notes: Check connectors, bends, splices and DP signal.

title: Inactive PPPoE session
description: The ONU appears normal but the router cannot establish a PPPoE session.
notes: Check PPPoE credentials, router WAN configuration and service profile.

title: Paid customer account remains disabled
description: The payment is recorded but the customer service account remains disabled.
notes: Verify the receipt and billing period before approved restoration.

title: Healthy service verification
description: The customer service is working and the supplied indicators appear normal.
